evidence.quote: I include indicator variables based on two-digit SIC codes to control for industry fixed effects.
Indicator variables based on two-digit SIC codes are included to control for industry fixed effects.

Statistical inference is based on Fama-MacBeth (1973) t-statistics based on the time-series of the annual coefficient estimates corrected for serial correlation using the Newey-West (1987) adjustment with three lags.
Intercept 0.012
I estimate annual cross-sectional regressions and report the time-series mean of the estimated coefficients.
These procedures and criteria yield a sample of 45,442 business-to-business relations, for a total of 25,389 unique supplier firm-years over the 30-year period from 1977 to 2006.
ROA is measured as the ratio of income before extraordinary items to the beginning of year book value of total assets
ROA (return on assets) measured as the ratio of income before extraordinary items to the beginning of year book value of total assets
Rank(CC)
Firms are ranked annually and assigned to deciles based on CC. The raw values of CC are replaced by the corresponding annual decile ranks scaled to lie between 0 (lowest rank) and 1 (highest rank).

CC_i,t = sum(j=1..J, (Sales_i,j,t / Sales_i,t)^2), where Sales_i,j,t is firm i sales to customer j and Sales_i,t is total firm sales in year t. The sum is across the firm's J reported major customers.
